verdict.rationale: Shopify publishes a live, cross-merchant discovery index: the Global Catalog MCP at catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp, which a runtime handshake confirmed. It lets agents search "hundreds of millions" of listings with offers from multiple merchants. Each storefront also publishes a /.well-known/ucp profile describing its services, capabilities and payment handlers, and a live storefront endpoint was confirmed. However, the index covers purchasable products and merchants rather than a general directory of payable services or APIs. Missing for 10: a published directory of payable services/APIs beyond Shopify product listings, a documented registry for enumerating UCP-enabled merchant endpoints, and independent corroboration of discovery coverage.
